claim_boundary: A lower-certificate improvement within a registered monotone prior-placement family, not a new Bellman algorithm, an optimal auditor, a globally optimal prior or multiplier, a model study, scientific priority, or independent human review. Zero-error and positive-error objectives are explicitly distinct; all older source-pinned files remain unchanged.
description:
Exact monotone-placement prior certificates for the original full grid.

Only the registered placement family and multipliers are compared. The
integer Bellman optimizers are relaxed prior-pair tests, not valid auditors.
Standard library only; actual populations are kept symbolic.

protocol.arithmetic: Exact rational placement constraints and independently implemented rolling Pascal/integer Bellman values, null-completion masses, costs, errors, and per-state checksums. No floating-point decision arithmetic or expanded actual population tables.

blind_mixture_arithmetic.interpretation: All allowed error is spent on blind immediate certification; this is an admissible comparison, not evidence-based efficiency.

protocol.claim_boundary: A lower-certificate improvement within a registered monotone prior-placement family, not a new Bellman algorithm, an optimal auditor, a globally optimal prior or multiplier, a model study, scientific priority, or independent human review. Zero-error and positive-error objectives are explicitly distinct; all older source-pinned files remain unchanged.
protocol.frontier_definition: For k=0..192 set b=192-k, fix the first H cells to zero and final b cells to one, and choose the smallest H with N=2048-H-b>=k+13 and fixed-bottom mass plus the first k unknown weights <=3/32 for every original target. Verify H-1 is infeasible whenever H>0.
protocol.progress: Informational stderr progress every 16 completed frontier geometries once calculation exceeds 60 seconds; elapsed time is not stored in results.
protocol.selection: Largest exact dual lower bound among only the 193 maximal-unknown-population frontiers and two registered multipliers; no optimality claim over other priors or all multipliers
protocol.sorting_matrix: M=1..7, all decreasing rows from combinations_with_replacement({0,1,2},M), all assignments in {fixed-zero,unknown,fixed-one}^M, and all k=0..number-of-unknowns. Check sorting head zeros and bottom ones does not increase the worst k-subset risk.
protocol.state_checksum: Same length-prefixed unsigned-big-endian SHA-256 state encoding as the frozen finite-decision checker; compare common-size cases in tests without mutating its population cap.
protocol.status: Fixed after exploratory mathematics and prior-pair screens, before the saved registered calculation; not external preregistration
protocol.title: Monotone placement and a stronger lower certificate for the original whole-grid decision

selected_registered_certificate.selection_scope: Only registered maximal-unknown-population frontiers and registered multipliers; separate clean witness excluded

dual_certificate.minimizing_policy_scope: Diagnostic optimizer of the prior-pair relaxation; not asserted to be a valid fixed-table auditor

structural_checks.interpretation: Finite arithmetic support for the sorting and latent-mixture proofs; no finite matrix establishes the universal structural theorem by itself.

zero_error_and_blind_mixture_checks.interpretation: These are exact arithmetic checks of the separately proved zero-error and blind-mixture statements. The randomized zero-error lower and deterministic exact result do not apply as lower bounds at positive delta.
